description: Spectrum points of asteroids measured by forced aperture photometry on SPHEREx DR1 Level-2 single exposures (public S3 bucket nasa-irsa-spherex), research prototype 2026-11-14. Top-level 'points' belong to the best-measured asteroid; a second asteroid is under 'additional_asteroids'.

units.wavelength_um: micron, central wavelength at the predicted pixel from the WCS-WAVE lookup table
units.bandwidth_um: micron, channel bandwidth at that pixel
units.flux_mJy: milli-jansky, r = 2 px circular aperture, local-annulus background subtracted, multiplied by aperture_correction (empirical r=2px -> r=4px curve of growth); NOT corrected for rotation or geometry
units.err_mJy: milli-jansky, from the VARIANCE extension plus background uncertainty (formal, underestimates the real scatter)
units.delta_au: distance from the SPHEREx spacecraft (Horizons centre 500@-163182)
units.flags: bitwise OR of the Level-2 FLAGS values of all pixels within 2.5 px of the predicted position
units.kept: true if the point passed the quality cuts and is used in the final spectrum
units.lightcurve_factor: fitted rotational brightness factor at that time (divide flux_mJy by it to get the rotation-averaged flux); 1.0 for visits that were not fitted
units.thermal_model_mJy: NEATM thermal flux for that exposure geometry with the fitted beaming parameter of its visit (applies to the rotation-averaged flux)
units.reflectance_norm_1p2um: (flux/lightcurve_factor - thermal) * r^2 * delta^2 / Phi_HG(phase) / F_sun(Kurucz, CALSPEC sun_mod_001), normalised to 1 at 1.20 micron
